jobs.title: Associate Director - Brand Strategy Analytics Oncology
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

Associate Director — Brand Strategy Analytics, Oncology, Digital Human Health
  
  

**Job Description:**  

This role sits within the Brand Strategy vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH) \- the patient\-centric capability that owns the analytics arc from patient journey through brand performance for the Oncology portfolio across both inline and pipeline assets. The team operates as an embedded partner to the commercial organization, providing strategic thought partnership to marketing and cross\-functional stakeholders. It shapes demand by translating business priorities into actionable analytics needs, quarterbacks delivery across DHH capabilities, and drives activation of products and insights to enable decision\-making and business impact.
  
  

The Associate Director will be responsible for developing and delivering strategic data insights and analytics that address Oncology BU teams key business questions and inform launch\-related and inline commercial decisions across the Oncology portfolio (covering Womens Cancer, Hematology, Lung, GU, GI, and the Oncology precision medicine and Early Assets are few). The team member will partner closely with Global and Regional market teams, , Sales, Enterprise Strategy, Clinical Development, and BD to inform executive decision\-making and increase commercial rigor through every phase of asset development, launch and inline.
  
  

The Associate Director will work alongside other DHH capability functions \- Market Research, Forecasting, Data Science, Data Strategy Solutions, Payer Insights Analytics, Data Visualisation, Commercial AI, IT \- to proactively orchestrate the planning and delivery of complex insights and analytics assessments.
  
The role partners closely with BU engagement leads to proactively shape and inform portfolio\-level brand strategy, while advancing capabilities through systematization, automation, and AI. The AD is accountable for positioning the India Hub as a strategic analytics partner, embedding productivity, scalability, and value\-driven outcomes across engagements.
  
  

**Role Overview:**  

The Associate Director will lead a team of Senior Managers, Managers, Associate Managers covering Oncology TA / asset and capability domains (Brand Performance Synthesis, Secondary Analytics, Patient Insights, Analytics Tool Activation). The candidate must be able to lead direct teams and orchestrate cross\-functional insights pods spanning DHH and the broader Human Health organisation. The individual will demonstrate consistently strong leadership, the ability to work objectively in ambiguity, strong partnership skills, a culture of continuous learning.
  
  

The preferred candidate will have an entrepreneurial spirit, a consultative and strategic mindset, strong Oncology TAs, fluency in technology (AI, GenAI, Agentic), and a demonstrated record of producing actionable insights from analytics. The individual should have a strong understanding of the US and exUS Oncology data landscape \- claims, EMR, real\-world data, biomarker data, Rx, market research data, and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into advanced, scalable analytical solutions.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Oncology portfolio analytics \- inline pipeline: Lead the development and synthesis of commercial data and insight solutions, portfolio analytics, business cases, performance measurements and market evaluations to support decision\-making for the Global and US Oncology teams.
* Brand strategy translation to analytics plan: Translate business needs and priorities into analytical plans that answer brand\-team and BD questions with actionable insights. Effectively communicate advanced analytics to commercial stakeholders to inform decisions across the value chain \- pipeline prioritization, product performance, launch readiness.
* Team leadership and cross\-functional orchestration: Lead and mentor 15 team members, providing guidance on best practices in data analytics, modeling and data visualization. Manage team workload proactively and ensure optimal resource utilization. Lead cross\-functional insights pods in addition to direct teams.
* Stakeholder collaboration: Drive proactive, transparent engagement with BU leads, cross\-functional partners to co\-create solutions, align on organizational priorities, and set clear expectations. Provide internal and business stakeholders with forward\-looking visibility into key programs to inform milestones, prioritization, risk mitigation, and aligned decision\-making.
* Prioritization and value tracking: Understand the full book of work underway and planned for each disease area or business unit. Work with BU leads to prioritise against team’s capacity. For prioritised work, engage cross\-functional teams to articulate the value and impact of each piece.
* Patient journey and RWD analytics: Build and oversee patient journey analytics, patient\-flow modeling, simulation\-based modeling, and other patient\-modeling techniques on commercial and real\-world datasets.
* Precision medicine and biomarker analytics: Embed analytics support for precision medicine and companion\-diagnostic priorities across the Oncology pipeline and inline portfolio, partnering with Precision Medicine Marketing, Outcomes Research and Medical Affairs.
* Communication and transparency: Drive proactive, transparent engagement with cross\-functional partners to co\-create solutions, align on organizational priorities, and set clear expectations. Provide internal and business stakeholders with forward\-looking visibility into key programs to inform milestones, prioritization, risk mitigation, and aligned decision\-making.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  

  

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Consumer and Community Banking, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  

  

**Job responsibilities*** Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Creates secure and high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Develop and enhance Java\-based backend services to support high\-volume transaction processing.
* Build and operate solutions using AWS services (e.g., Aurora Postgres, ECS/Fargate, EC2 as applicable) with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Contribute to solution design by partnering with senior engineers/architects and participating in design reviews to ensure implementations align with technical standards and business needs.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, where approved) to improve development efficiency, testing, and code quality.
* Follow and promote strong engineering practices (code reviews, CI/CD, testing, observability, documentation) and continuously improve the codebase.
* Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into technical deliverables.
* Support security and compliance requirements by applying secure coding practices and adhering to Community Banking standards and applicable regulatory expectations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Demonstrated experience with Java backend development, object\-oriented design, and common design patterns.
* Experience with AWS (e.g., Aurora Postgres, ECS/Fargate, Glue and/or Airflow) and building distributed services.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to learn quickly in a complex domain.
* Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.
* Hands\-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle. Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Financial services and/or connected commerce experience is a plus, but not required.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., Copilot) is a plus (confirm tool approval for your environment before use).

* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies
* Exposure to cloud technologies

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 Shape the future of digital product innovation by building solutions that create measurable value for clients. Join a collaborative team where you will influence strategy, drive delivery, and accelerate your career through growth and mobility opportunities. Bring your product leadership, customer focus, and execution rigor to deliver high\-quality launches that matter.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Vice President, Product Manager at JPMorgan Chase within Global Customer Platform, you will be an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with technology, design, data, operations, and business stakeholders to define outcomes and deliver against a clear roadmap. You will translate client needs into prioritized capabilities, balancing speed to market with reliability and risk\-aware delivery. You will use data and customer insights to guide decisions, measure adoption, and continuously improve the product experience. Success requires strong stakeholder management, crisp communication, and disciplined execution across discovery, build, launch, and iteration.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Define product vision and strategy aligned to customer needs, business outcomes, and platform capabilities.
* Lead discovery and market research to identify problems, validate hypotheses, and convert insights into roadmap priorities.
* Own the product roadmap and backlog, ensuring clear prioritization, well\-defined requirements, and readiness for delivery.
* Partner with design and engineering to shape solutions, evaluate trade\-offs, and deliver releases that meet quality and reliability expectations.
* Establish success metrics and track outcomes across cost, feature performance, customer experience, risk posture, and reliability.
* Drive end\-to\-end launch planning, including stakeholder alignment, release readiness, communications, and post\-launch measurement.
* Incorporate customer feedback and production insights to iterate, address defects, and improve usability and value over time.
* Align cross\-functional stakeholders on scope, timelines, dependencies, and decisions to ensure transparent delivery execution.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience in product management or a closely related domain.
* Experience leading end\-to\-end product lifecycle activities (discovery, ideation, requirements definition, delivery, and iteration).
* Advanced knowledge of product development lifecycle practices, including backlog management and roadmap planning.
* Experience using data analytics to define product metrics, evaluate performance, and inform prioritization decisions.
* Ability to translate customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience partnering with cross\-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and business stakeholders) to deliver product outcomes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready status updates and decision framing.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization.


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.
   

  

 We are here to help you manage your money with checking, savings and credit cards, combining the latest banking technology with comprehensive solutions to meet the financial needs of nearly half of U.S. households.

**Job Description**
 This role will be central to advancing Experian's next\-generation fraud platform capabilities, focused on delivering a modular, platform\-native, and extensible Digital Intelligence ecosystem that powers device intelligence, behavioral analytics, and behavioral biometrics across the customer lifecycle—from onboarding to authentication and account management.
   

  

* The Senior Product Manager will lead initiatives that strengthen Experian's Ascend Fraud Platform by enhancing device identification, cross\-environment recognition, ML\-driven intelligence, and proprietary risk signals, while reducing reliance on third\-party vendors and improving customer outcomes.
* This role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with global and regional product teams, engineering, data science, and go\-to\-market stakeholders to execute high\-impact product initiatives from concept through launch and scale.
* This is an ideal opportunity for a Product Manager with strong domain expertise in Device Intelligence, Fraud Detection \& Prevention, and platform products, who can translate complex business and technical requirements into scalable solutions that drive revenue protection, cost efficiency, and competitive differentiation.


**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and execute the strategy for Unified Digital Intelligence, aligning with Experian's broader fraud platform vision and Ascend ecosystem
* Drive evolution from legacy systems toward a platform\-native, microservices\-based device intelligence architecture
* Deliver a roadmap that strengthens Experian's market position against competitors


**Market Research \& Competitive Intelligence**
* Analyze industry trends across device intelligence, behavioral analytics, and fraud prevention ecosystems
* Identify opportunities to expand capabilities in behavioral biometrics, AI\-driven fraud detection, and cross\-channel intelligence
* Continuously evaluate build vs. buy decisions to reduce vendor dependency and unlock strategic advantage


**Product Discovery \& Customer Insights**
* Engage with customers, partners, and regional teams to identify key pain points across fraud use cases
* Translate insights into actionable product requirements that improve fraud detection accuracy and reduce customer friction
* Validate opportunities that accelerate client adoption and integration velocity


**Data\-Driven Product Management**
* Use quantitative and qualitative data to optimize fraud detection performance and signal quality, reduce false positives and customer friction, prioritize features and investments


**Go\-To\-Market \& Adoption**
* Partner with GTM, sales, and customer success teams to enable successful launches and feature adoption
* Accelerate onboarding via simplified integration (e.g., hosted collectors, SDKs)


**Qualifications**

* Strong domain expertise in Fraud, Risk, Device Intelligence, or Identity solutions
* 5\+ years of experience building platform products, APIs, microservices, and SDK\-based solutions
* Proven track record of delivering products that drive revenue impact, cost savings, or scalability improvements
* Experience working with AI/ML\-driven products, including model lifecycle and data\-driven decision\-making

We are seeking an analytical and technically precise **QA Engineer (2\+ Years)** on behalf of our premium technology client. In this role, you will own the quality footprint across our web platforms, backend REST APIs, and core AI\-driven features. You will balance hands\-on exploratory manual testing with robust automation engineering—building scalable test suites, verifying data pipeline integrity via SQL, and establishing specialized validation protocols to test the accuracy, consistency, and edge\-case behaviors of machine learning models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Test Engineering Architecture:** Design, author, and preserve comprehensive test plans, complex test matrices, and mock test data across web, API, and data environments.
* **Multi\-Tier Quality Execution:** Perform rigorous functional, regression, multi\-tier integration, and unstructured exploratory testing across scheduled production releases.
* **Automation Engineering:** Build, calibrate, and maintain scalable automated test suites targeting both the user interface (UI) and service layers.
* **AI/ML Validation:** Validate AI/ML outputs and algorithm performance by systematically checking for statistical accuracy, model drift consistency, structural bias, and graceful failure handling.
* **API \& Pipeline Testing:** Test REST APIs and underlying data pipelines to verify schema definitions, payload quality, and integration correctness.
* **Defect Lifecycle Governance:** Document, log, track, and triage systemic software defects within tracking systems, verifying technical fixes through to clean closure.
* **Agile DevOps Collaboration:** Partner directly with Product Owners, Data Scientists, and Backend Engineers to embed quality frameworks throughout rapid Agile/Scrum sprints.

**Mandatory Selection Criteria (Applications without these will not be considered):**

* **Overall Experience:** Minimum **2\+ years** of professional experience in QA / Software Testing, with a verified balance of both manual and automation execution.

* **Automation Frameworks:** Hands\-on automation experience utilizing tools such as **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress**, or a comparable enterprise framework.
* **Scripting Languages:** Strong working proficiency in **Python, JavaScript, or Java** dedicated to test automation scripting.
* **API Testing Tools:** Proven experience testing REST APIs and backend data structures using tools like **Postman, REST Assured**, or equivalent libraries.
* **SQL \& Data Mastery:** Robust data manipulation skills with the ability to write custom SQL queries to validate backend database integrity and data state transformations.
* **QA Methodology:** Complete command over core QA methodologies, SDLC/STLC lifecycle gates, and modern Agile/Scrum execution models.
* **Soft Skills:** Sharp analytical mindset, extreme attention to detail, and a clear, descriptive style of defect communication.

Governance

* Responsible for continuous process improvement and ensuring adherence to governance, risk and control standards.
* Responsible for monitoring control frameworks for Markets and Baking product control activities to ensure Balance Sheet and P\&L Integrity.

Ads is essential. Offline marketing campaigns and experience is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**
 Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 
   

  

 BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 
   

  

 We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
 



 Senior Product Managers at Blink are innovators, craftspeople and business thinkers. Your job as a Sr Product Manager is to take ownership over our hardest problems, envision and refine strategic solutions, and drive execution like an entrepreneur. You will collaborate closely with a talented, cross\-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers, data scientists, marketers, and operators. Through these partnerships, you’ll grow our business, build our core platform, and \- above all \- make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth.  
 



 At Blink, we determine the specific focus of product roles through the interview process. Key potential areas of ownership include: our telemedicine platform; our home delivery experience; our growth team; our core cloud pharmacy platform; new product line development and strategic platforms. We’ll work with you to find the right fit. All PM roles include driving product strategy, roadmapping, rapid testing and research, release planning, experimentation and analysis. PMs are expected to become true experts in pharmacy systems \- so that we can transform them. And they are expected to become experts in our customers \- so that we can provide a truly unparalleled experience to them.
 



 While this role is based in India, you will work on global products that require partnership with teams across regions. We are also aggressively growing our teams in India and this role will be one of our founding product based roles here.
 



**About You** 



* Experienced \- you have 6\+ years as a product manager, either with strong consumer or deep platform experience.
* Proven Builder \- you have delivered multiple successful and innovative products from ‘0 to 1 to n’. You can point directly to growth/engagement/success metrics on these products.
* Consumer\-Obsessed \- you always think first about the consumer, hunt for empathy, and do everything possible to give the customer the best possible experience.
* Analytical \- you naturally break hard problems into their pieces, are deeply familiar with best\-in\-class experimentation practices, use key results to drive strategies, and basically just measure everything.
* Driven and Biased\-to\-Action \- you can manage through complexity, lead with influence, make hard decisions, and persevere when things are challenging. You are hungry to win and you have the grit to make it happen.
* Collaborative and Communicative \- you love being part of a diverse team, building consensus, and establishing credibility. You are a Class\-A communicator: curious, thoughtful, clear, and (mostly) correct.
* Technical \- an engineering background/skills are highly preferred for Product roles at Blink. You will work closely with engineering teams and will need to appreciate technical nuances of the solutions being built.
* BE/B Tech degree from top institution; MBA or Computer Science degree preferred but not mandatory.



**Why Join Us:**
 It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a Technology or Business related field.
* Experience in end\-to\-end foundation model integration, agentic workflows, and production performance trade\-offs.
* Ability to rapidly build functional POCs and validate hypotheses using AI\-assisted coding tools.
* Proven track record of incubating, validating, and launching 0\-to\-1 AI products from scratch.
* Excellent product judgment and domain expertise across Google Play consumer surfaces, gaming, and developer ecosystems.
* Excellent executive communication skills to influence cross\-functional leaders and align strategic road\-maps.


**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 AI Innovation and Research Accelerator (AIRX) is a part of AIR, a standalone team within Platforms and Devices (P\&D), that is known for building cutting\-edge AI product experiences and getting them to billions of users.
   

  

 You will build the next generation of user experiences across P\&D by building on frontier AI model and partnering directly with Google Play Product and Engineering teams to turn green\-field research into shipped impact for developers and users.
   

  

 Working at AIRX, you can expect to:
   

  

* Build products and define the path from zero\-to\-one.
* Build bridges between exceptional research and product execution by fostering consensus and collaboration.
* See your work move from research to shipped products quickly.
* Outsize impact by operating across various product areas, influencing how billions of users experience AI across the ecosystem.


 The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead 0\-to\-1 AI Product Incubation: Drive rapid prototyping and user\-centric validation to test UX feasibility and establish product\-market fit for novel consumer and developer surfaces across Google Play.
* Bridge Frontier AI Research and Product Execution: Serve as the core liaison between AIR, Google DeepMind, and Google Play leadership to translate cutting\-edge foundation models and agentic workflows into production\-ready features.
* Accelerate Ecosystem AI Integrations: Identify and deliver high\-impact AI opportunities across key Play pillars, including the core Play Store experience, gaming, business generation, and developer tooling.
* Lead Strategic Product Roadmaps: Define the goal and drive end\-to\-end execution for emerging initiatives such as AI\-powered game development, automated store merchandising, and next\-generation discovery.
* Drive Cross\-Functional Alignment and Delivery: Manage multiple parallel workstreams, align stakeholder consensus across organizational boundaries, and lead initiatives from initial concept through to landing.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 Instant access to an active base of 20M\+ users, backed by Flipkart’s 450M\+ shopper ecosystem.

 A seat at the table for one of the most strategic bets in super.money’s journey \- building a commerce vertical from scratch on India’s fastest\-growing UPI app.

 At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

 Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars \- Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
   

  
   

 Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles \-simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
   

  
   

**Salary** 
 \- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
   

  
   

**Leave \& Time\-off**

 \- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in\-laws. 
   

  
   

**Mental Wellbeing** 
 \- We offer mental health support through self\-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face\-to\-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
   

  
   

**Financial Wellbeing** 
 \- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one\-to\-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
   

  
   

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** 
 \- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3\-year savings plan.  
   

  
   

**Physical Wellbeing** 
 \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
   

  

**About Us**
 At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
   

  
   

  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
   

  
   

  We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

**Our Product**
 BlueOptima provides industry\-leading objective metrics in software development using our proprietary Coding Effort Analytics; enabling Fortune 500 organizations to deliver better software, faster and more efficiently.
   

  

 We currently are located in 5 countries: London (our HQ), Mexico, India, US and Japan. A total number of 110\+ employees (and increasing every day) from different nationalities and with over 25 languages spoken.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore

 Engineering

 Code Insights is BlueOptima's application security product — helping engineering and security teams ship secure code faster by catching exposed secrets, static analysis (SAST) vulnerabilities, and risky open\-source dependencies (SCA) before they reach production. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own this product end to end: its roadmap, its narrative, and its commercial outcome.

* Retention \& commercial outcome — Success is tied directly to retention goals, so you're accountable for customers staying and growing, alongside deals closing.

* Partner with engineering to ship high\-quality, well\-scoped releases; own the trade\-off calls when scope, timeline, and security depth conflict.
* Report product health, risk, and roadmap progress directly to senior leadership — including exec/C\-suite settings — with the judgment to say what leadership needs to hear, not just what's easy to report.
* Be the External and Internal Face of the Product
* Pitch Code Insights directly to CISOs, SecOps leads, and security architects; be comfortable being challenged on technical depth and defending the product's position against competing SAST, SCA, and secrets\-detection tools.
* Own customer pilots end to end, from technical validation through commercial conversion — you carry the pilot, not just support it.
* Close the loop from field to roadmap: translate customer and prospect input into product decisions, and be willing to say no to requests that don't fit the strategy.
* Represent the product internally to sales, marketing, and execs as the person who can explain not just what Code Insights does, but why it wins and where it's still catching up.
* Grow the Product\-Led Opportunity (Growth Track)
* Use Code Insights' shift\-left, developer\-first design (CLI, pre\-commit hooks, CI/CD integration) as a foundation to build organic, self\-serve adoption.
* Partner with Design and Marketing to test and refine the self\-serve journey — from first scan to habitual use to internal champion.
* Treated as a strategic opportunity to grow into, not a prerequisite — we'll support you in building this muscle if it's new to you.


**What We're Looking For:**
 We're looking for technical judgment and business fluency in the same person:
   

  

* Seniority — 6–7\+ years in product management or a customer\-facing technical role, with real ownership of roadmap decisions, not just execution.

* Communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and business implications to technical teams effectively.

* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), process maps, data flow diagrams, and user manuals.

* Technical Acumen: API concepts, system integration, database fundamentals.
* Testing Support: Acceptance criteria, UAT.
* Documentation: Comprehensive project artifacts.

At Okta, we're building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we're specifically focused on protecting the future of work. * You keep user goals at the heart of your solution and can also balance business objectives and engineering considerations.
* You thrive in ambiguous environments and know when to lead versus when to lean on your team members.
* You build and share empathy with people in order to deeply understand them and their needs.
* You are someone who sees design as a partner with PM and Engineering in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes
* You are comfortable owning all stages of design for multiple teams within a given product area.
* You are passionate about upholding design UX principles

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
   

  

 As a Product Owner \& Requirement Engineer, you will serve as the critical link between business stakeholders, end users, architects, and agile delivery teams. Your day will involve translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, managing and prioritizing the product backlog, and ensuring that product deliveries generate measurable business value. You will drive collaboration across cross\-functional teams, helping shape product vision, define roadmaps, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.
   

  

 How You'll Make an Impact
   

  

 Requirements Engineering
   

  

* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, stakeholder interviews, and business process analysis sessions.
* Create and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process flows, use cases, and user stories.
* Define and manage acceptance criteria while ensuring full requirements traceability.
* Assess and manage requirement changes, including impact analysis.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements, solution architecture, and technical design.


 Product Ownership
   

  

* Own, manage, and continuously refine the product backlog.
* Prioritize features, enhancements, defects, and user stories based on business value and strategic goals.
* Partner with stakeholders to define product vision, roadmap, and release priorities.
* Ensure backlog readiness for development teams through effective grooming and refinement activities.
* Support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Validate delivered functionality and formally accept completed user stories.
* Communicate product progress, priorities, and expectations to stakeholders.


 Stakeholder \& Delivery Management
   

  

* Act as the primary point of contact for requirements, product priorities, and stakeholder alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business users, software engineers, architects, UX designers, and project managers.
* Identify and resolve risks, dependencies, and delivery bottlenecks.
* Ensure delivered solutions meet business objectives and customer expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement through stakeholder feedback, product metrics, and data\-driven decision\-making.


 What You Bring
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise application delivery, and product development.
* 5\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst, or a similar role within Agile environments.
* Proven track record in requirements management, backlog ownership, stakeholder engagement, and end\-to\-end product delivery.
* Strong experience working with cross\-functional teams, business stakeholders, architects, and software development teams.
* Experience operating within Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) frameworks.
* Professional Product Owner certifications such as PSPO, CSPO, or equivalent certifications are preferred.


 Technical \& Functional Skills
   

  

* Requirements elicitation, analysis, and management.
* Business process modeling (BPMN, process mapping).
* User story creation, backlog refinement, and prioritization.
* Product roadmap planning and value\-driven delivery.
* Acceptance criteria definition and testing support.
* Agile/Scrum/SAFe methodologies.


 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

* Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar backlog management platforms.
* Confluence, Polarion, DOORS, or other requirements management tools.
* Strong understanding of SDLC practices.
* Knowledge of APIs, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications is an advantage.


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong communication, presentation, and facilitation capabilities.
* Analytical mindset with exceptional problem\-solving skills.
* Effective negotiation and prioritization abilities.
* Ability to influence and lead without direct authority.
* Strong customer focus and ownership mentality.


**About The Team**
 You will join a highly collaborative and agile product organization focused on delivering innovative digital solutions that enhance business performance and user experience. Working alongside architects, developers, UX specialists, and business leaders, you will play a key role in transforming strategic objectives into successful products and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 Success Measures
   

  

 Success in this role will be measured through:
   

  

* Delivery of high\-quality and clearly documented requirements.
* Product backlog health, readiness, and prioritization effectiveness.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement.
* Timely delivery of business value and product outcomes.
* Reduction in requirement\-related defects, rework, and delivery risks.
* Achievement of product goals, strategic objectives, and business KPIs.


 Who You Are
   

  

 You are a product\-minded professional who combines strong business analysis capabilities with a passion for product ownership. You thrive in agile environments, excel at translating complex business needs into clear solutions, and are motivated by delivering products that create meaningful value for customers and the business alike.

 In the

 ProBuddy Software Solutions is a fast\-growing technology company specializing in
 **Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), enterprise software solutions, AI\-powered applications, and digital transformation services** 
 . We partner with global organizations to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-quality software solutions that help businesses streamline operations, manage risks, and achieve compliance.
 



 At ProBuddy, we foster a
 **collaborative, learning\-driven environment**

 About the Role

 **proactive, analytical, and experienced Business Analyst with 3–4 years of experience** 
 to join our Product \& Strategy team.
 



 The ideal candidate will work closely with
 **business stakeholders, product managers, developers, QA teams, UI/UX teams, and clients** 
 to understand business needs, gather and analyze requirements, define functional solutions, and ensure successful product delivery.

 **AI\-driven product initiatives**

 and validate that delivered features meet business requirements.

 **data analysis using Excel and SQL** 
 to support business decisions, requirement validation, and product improvements.

 **AI\-enabled features, business use cases, workflows, and expected outcomes** 
 .
* Identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and potential impacts of proposed business solutions.
* Maintain project and product documentation and ensure
 **end\-to\-end traceability** 
 between requirements, development, testing, and delivered solutions.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders and provide regular updates on requirements, issues, and project progress.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing user feedback, business processes, and product performance.

 **Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field** 
 .
* **3–4 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst** 
 in Enterprise Software, SaaS, Product Development, or Digital Transformation projects.
* Strong experience in
 **requirement gathering, requirement analysis, process mapping, and functional documentation** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience preparing
 **BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases, process flows, and acceptance criteria** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **SDLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and software product development** 
 .
* Good understanding of
 **API concepts, application workflows, databases, and system integrations** 
 is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Strong
 **stakeholder management and communication skills** 
 .
* Proficiency in
 **Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and documentation tools** 
 .
* Working knowledge of
 **SQL** 
 for data analysis, validation, and reporting.
* Ability to independently manage requirements and coordinate with multiple cross\-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify gaps and translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications.


 Preferred Skills
 * Experience working with
 **AI\-powered applications, intelligent automation, Generative AI, or machine\-learning\-enabled products** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with Business Analysis and project management tools such as
 **Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, Lucidchart, or Figma** 
 .
* Knowledge of
 **manual testing concepts, UAT, test case validation, and defect management** 
 .
* Experience working in
 **enterprise software, SaaS, workflow automation, ERP, CRM, or GRC platforms** 
 .
* Exposure to
 **Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC)** 
 concepts is an added advantage.
* Understanding of
 **REST APIs and system integrations** 
 is a plus.
* Experience interacting directly with
 **clients or international stakeholders** 
 is preferred.
* Certification in Business Analysis such as
 **ECBA, CCBA, or CBAP** 
 is a plus.

 We are seeking a Business Analyst (Analytics \& Automation) to serve as the coordination layer between the Quality, Safety \& Environment (QHSE) function and the Corporate Analytics \& Automation team. The role focuses on requirement gathering, BI and Power App delivery coordination, and monthly reporting with analysis across the QHSE area, strengthening resilience, continuity, and a scalable, governed delivery model.
